Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

happy — feeling good and pleased. Example: I am happy today.
excited — feeling very interested and happy. Example: I am excited about the news.
delighted — very pleased. Example: I am delighted about the news.
proud — pleased about something good you did. Example: My parents are proud.
lucky — having good things happen to you. Example: I am lucky today.
smile — to make a happy face. Example: I can't stop smiling.
news — information about recent events. Example: I have got great news!
feeling — an emotion or physical state. Example: I have a good feeling today.
great — very good. Example: I have got great news!
wonderful — extremely good. Example: It is wonderful news.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I am happy.
• I have got great news!
• I am so excited.
• My parents are proud.
• It is wonderful news.
